title: How to Apply Sticky Tabs for Press-On Nails (Natural & Long-Lasting Fit 💅)
description:
Want your press-on nails to look salon-perfect and stay on longer? 💅 Learn the proper way to apply sticky tabs for a secure, natural-looking fit. Start with nail prep—push back cuticles, file the surface, and clean thoroughly. Choose the right size sticky tab and apply it carefully (not too close to the cuticle). Warm it with a hair dryer for 10 seconds, then press and activate the adhesive. Finally, place your press-on nail slightly above the cuticle, gently roll it down, and hold for 10 seconds for a strong, flawless finish.

The AI chip is a game-changer too: it senses when the brush is near your skin and speeds up for deep cleaning, then saves power when it’s not. Plus, IPX7 waterproof means you can rinse it directly under the shower without a worry. With 3 interchangeable heads (soft for daily care, exfoliating for smoothness, massage for relaxation), every shower feels like a tailored treat for your skin!
